title: CZA: Triple Duel
tagline: CZA — Lock tokens, play a fast 3-round card duel, drop a nuke, winner takes the pool
description:
CZA: Is fast, 30-second PvP games anyone can play, built for quick decisions and instant feedback. Pick a champion, jump straight into the arena, and win rewards through simple, skill-based matches. No crypto-savvy flows, or even a wallet is required to play. Yet there's optional betting for players who want higher stakes and degen-style action.

Who won't like a game with Cowboys, Zombies, and Alien collectibles?
how_its_made: I used Next.js for the frontend, Figma Community for assets and inspiration, and Yellow Network as the intent layer to track game activity and release rewards. The stack includes Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, and viem for chain interaction, with ENS + viem hooks to fetch wallet domains. I use Redis for realtime features, everything is hosted on Vercel, and for wallet auth I chose the easiest setup to get running: Privy.
